headline: Kwangjin SLP Mexico S.A. de C.V Hit by Ransomware Attack
body: Kwangjin SLP Mexico S.A. de C.V, a prominent automotive components supplier, has disclosed a ransomware attack that compromised its network for several weeks. During this period, a large volume of internal data was exfiltrated by the attackers. Despite this breach, Kwangjin SLP Mexico S.A. de C.V reported that its business operations have continued without interruption. The company has engaged cybersecurity incident responders and has involved the relevant authorities to address the situation.
